normalizedResponse.reasoning: Single-timestamp price data prevents empirical correlation matrix estimation. LINK price is missing from context. stETH/ETH are near-perfect substitutes and provide no diversification. Actionable implications: (1) cap aggregate crypto beta at 60%, (2) diversify into uncorrelated assets available in context—GLD and TLT—as ballast, (3) use USDC/DAI for liquidity buffers, (4) avoid stETH as a diversifier.
